statement: ∀ A : Set (GP.Space 0), A = Set.univ → (fun t : ℝ => GP.join (0 : GP.Space 0) t) '' GP.unitInterval = GP.cylinder A
proof:
intro A hA
ext z
constructor
· rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · rw [hA]
    trivial
  · simpa [GP.vertical, GP.join, Fin.snoc_zero] using ht
· intro hz
  refine ⟨GP.vertical z, hz.2, ?_⟩
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  rfl
